how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-stormwind-city-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:212:obj:0: Kill a Cold Eye Basilisk, get a Chilled Basilisk Haunch, and return it to ⟦E1⟧ Stern in the Blue Recluse.
rows.quest:212:details:0: One of my most famous dishes is Chilled Basilisk in Lime Vinaigrette. But the problem is... the meat is impossible to keep fresh, and I must serve the dish tonight for a noble's birthday!
rows.quest:212:details:1: BSo if you can bring me a Chilled Basilisk Haunch from a freshly-killed Cold Eye Basilisk, quickly, then I will owe you a king's feast!
rows.quest:212:details:2: BCold Eye Basilisks are known to roam along the beach dunes of northwestern Stranglethorn, so you have much traveling to do. And be swift!
rows.quest:212:completion:0: Ah, this will do nicely! Many, many thanks!
rows.quest:212:completion:1: BNow if you'll excuse me, I must get the haunch chopped, marinated and garnished for the banquet.
rows.quest:332:obj:0: Go to the Gallina Winery, and bring Suzetta Gallina the Wine Ticket for a free bottle of wine.
rows.quest:332:details:0: If you talk to anyone about wine, then you know we Gallinas sell the best wine in ⟦E2⟧. And we're not far, still in the Trade District along the city's lovely canals.
rows.quest:332:details:1: BHere, take this pamphlet. Bring it to my sister Suzetta at our shop for a complimentary bottle of our famous pinot noir. You won't regret it!
rows.quest:332:completion:0: Ah, so you've seen Renato? Well here you are, ⟦1⟧. A bottle of our special pinot noir. You'll not find its equal in all of ⟦E3⟧!
rows.quest:333:obj:0: Go to the Canal Tailor Shop and bring Rema Schneider the Cloth Request from Harlan Bagley.
rows.quest:333:details:0: We've been doing a lot of business lately. It seems like everyone is buying armor and sturdy clothes. Almost like they expect a cold, harsh season ahead...
rows.quest:333:details:1: BBut those are future worries. My worry today is that I'm running out of knitted clothing to sell. I need another load from our supplier.
rows.quest:333:details:2: BIf you can take this request to Rema Schneider at the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop, I'd be most grateful.
rows.quest:333:completion:0: It says here that Harlan's business is booming. That's good news, but I wonder why people have need of all that armor. I've heard nothing of open war... is there something the nobles aren't telling us?
rows.quest:333:completion:1: BWell, thank you for bringing the request. Here's your payment, and I'll see to it that Harlan gets his supplies.
rows.quest:334:obj:0: Go to the Larson Clothiers in the ⟦E2⟧ Mage Quarter, and give Thurman Schneider his Sewing Kit.
rows.quest:334:details:0: My son Thurman is an apprentice at the Larson Clothiers, in the Mage's Quarter. He was in a hurry today and forgot his shears and needles. I know a great ⟦2⟧ like you must have important tasks at hand, but without his tools Thurman can't do his apprentice work!
rows.quest:334:details:1: BPlease, ⟦3⟧. Can you take my son's sewing kit to him? Larson Clothiers is one of two clothing shops in the Mage's Quarter - it's the one deeper in, near the Mage's Tower.
rows.quest:334:completion:0: Oh, blast! I thought forgetting my kit would free me from work. Now I guess I'll have to help the Larsons with their sewing...
rows.quest:334:completion:1: BOh, well. Fun will come later I guess.
rows.quest:335:obj:0: Zardeth the Black ⟦E4⟧ wants you to bring him a Tear of Tilloa from Darkshire and a Musquash Root from the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:335:details:0: Lord Wishock is causing quite a stir amongst the House of Nobles. He was made aware of our little "establishment" down here and is lobbying for a full investigation. I have a plan to keep Wishock "preoccupied", but I'll need your help.
rows.quest:335:details:1: BThere is a flower growing in the Garden of Stalvan on the outskirts of Darkshire. This small white flower is known as the Tear of Tilloa. I will also need a Musquash Root, found only at the very base of the falls far beneath the Stonewrought Dam in the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:335:completion:0: Most excellent! These are fine samples indeed!
rows.quest:336:obj:0: Take the Black ⟦E4⟧ Stout to Lord Wishock in the Hall of Petitioners.
rows.quest:336:details:0: Lord Wishock, like all men, has his weaknesses. His happens to be a fondness for liquor. The hypocrisy is astounding. The trite fool spends his days trying to shut down our little "tavern" while his nights are spent upstairs, running up a bill he never pays. Well, let's see how Wishock likes this special brew I have prepared for him: Black ⟦E4⟧ stout. It's got quite a kick, ⟦4⟧.
rows.quest:336:details:1: BTake it to him and see how he likes it. Most likely the old fool is milling about the Hall of Petitioners.
rows.quest:336:completion:0: Ah, thank you for bringing me this fine looking stout, servant. Here's a copper for you. Now, out of sight with you and let me enjoy my drink!
rows.quest:343:obj:0: Go to the Royal Library in ⟦E2⟧ Keep and speak with Milton Sheaf. He can find for you the book on metallurgy that Brother Kristoff needs for his speech.
rows.quest:343:details:0: I'm giving a speech on the Fortitude of the Spirit, and I'd like to recite passages from a particular book on metallurgy - "The Stresses of Iron." A copy of this book should be in the Royal Library, within ⟦E2⟧ Keep. Can you retrieve it for me? If so, then may the blessings of the Light be with you!
rows.quest:343:details:1: BThe Royal Library is very large, but the head librarian, Milton Sheaf, knows each shelf like it was his own son. Speak to him, he'll retrieve the book for you.
rows.quest:343:completion:0: Metallurgy? Ah yes, we have many books on the subject, and are happy to aid Brother Kristoff with his speech! Now...which particular book was it the good brother needed?
rows.quest:344:obj:0: Speak with Brother Paxton in the ⟦E6⟧ Abbey.
rows.quest:344:details:0: The Stresses of Iron? Yes, I know the book. Quite a good one, written by the Dwarven miner Margulf Blaggon a few decades ago. He spent most his time deep in the mountains of Khaz Modan, digging ore. Smart fellow!
rows.quest:344:details:1: BBut where was I? Oh yes, the Stresses of Iron! I'm afraid the book was moved to the ⟦E6⟧ Abbey. The caretaker of the Abbey's library, Brother Paxton, wanted to make a copy of the book for his own shelves.
rows.quest:344:details:2: BBut that was months ago. I wonder why it's taking him so long...
rows.quest:344:completion:0: Mr. Sheaf is wondering where his book is? Well this is a tad embarrassing. I have the book, but I'm still making my copy and I'm not quite ready to give the original up!
rows.quest:345:obj:0: Speak with ⟦E7⟧ Oslow in Lakeshire and ask him for Rethban Iron Ore.
rows.quest:345:details:0: I've been meaning to finish my copy of The Stresses of Iron, but...
rows.quest:345:details:1: BWell you see, I make my own ink for books I copy. It's my own recipe; it doesn't run or smear, and it dries very quickly Unfortunately, it dries too quickly! My last batch dried up before I could finish the copying job, and I haven't had the chance to make more ink!
rows.quest:345:details:2: BTo make more I need Rethban Iron Ore from the ⟦E8⟧. ⟦E7⟧ Oslow in Lakeshire is my usual supplier.
rows.quest:345:completion:0: You need what?? Maybe you haven't noticed, but we're busy fortifying Lakeshire's defenses and repairing damage from recent orc attacks. If you need Rethban Iron Ore, you'll have to get it yourself!
rows.quest:346:obj:0: Return to Brother Kristoff in the Cathedral Square. Give him the book The Stresses of Iron.
rows.quest:346:details:0: Now that I've finished copying the book, here's the original Stresses of Iron. Thank you for your patience, and if you see Milton please tell him I'm sorry for the long delay.
rows.quest:346:completion:0: That's the one! Thank you, ⟦5⟧. May the Light shine brightly upon both your body and spirit!
rows.quest:347:obj:0: Gather 5 loads of Rethban Ore and bring it to Brother Paxton in the ⟦E6⟧ Library.
rows.quest:347:details:0: Rethban Ore is named after the man who first found it, Bart Rethban. When smelted it's not as strong as iron, but its ore has a dark, flat color that some scribes use in their dyes. It can be found in the Rethban Caverns, north of here.
rows.quest:347:details:1: BWe usually have some in stock, but we're too busy preparing for Orc attacks to gather any. And besides...Redridge Gnolls are now living in the Rethban Caverns and their Drudgers are gathering the ore themselves.
rows.quest:347:details:2: BSo if you need some, you'll have to get it yourself.
rows.quest:347:completion:0: Oh, splendid! I can use this ore to make my dye, and then can finish copying The Stresses of Iron.
rows.quest:350:details:0: That Marzon would be contacting a member of the Defias and have ties to Lescovar...
rows.quest:350:details:1: BHaving killed VanCleef and Thredd, it would be hard to see Lescovar brought to proper justice, as your evidence is nothing without their testimonies. That is not even considering the fact that Lescovar is a noble and well connected. It effectively makes him above the law.
rows.quest:350:details:2: BYou'll need other help. I loathe to do so, but there is someone I know that will aid us. You'll find Trias in the Trade District of the city.
rows.quest:350:completion:0: You're kidding? Shaw wants my help again? Of all the nerve...
rows.quest:350:completion:1: BThe Defias Brotherhood, you say? Well, you're certainly the bearer of wonderful news, aren't you? Next you're going to tell me that ⟦E9⟧ is still alive and attacking the city.
rows.quest:350:completion:2: BAll right, tell me everything from the beginning. And don't leave out something you think might not be important. I need to know it all.
rows.quest:353:obj:0: Deliver the Package for Stormpike to Mountaineer Stormpike in ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:353:details:0: The Stormpikes are a respected dwarven clan, and are well known for their fine and discerning tastes. So it's no wonder that Gringer Stormpike, a Mountaineer of ⟦E11⟧, commissioned me to craft him a weapon.
rows.quest:353:details:1: BThe weapon is finished, but... Mountaineer Stormpike is far away, in distant ⟦E10⟧. If you plan on traveling to the north, can you deliver this package to him?
rows.quest:353:details:2: BMy last message from Mountaineer Stormpike said he's stationed at the northern guard tower in ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:353:completion:0: Aha! So Grimand finally finished my axe! I can't wait to try it against some troggs and kobolds!
rows.quest:353:completion:1: BMany thanks, ⟦7⟧. It was a long distance to travel for this delivery. Here are some coins for your efforts.
rows.quest:373:obj:0: Deliver the Letter to the City Architect to Baros Alexston in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:373:details:0: Searching Edwin VanCleef's person, you discover, among other things, an unsent letter. It is addressed to Baros Alexston, the City Architect of ⟦E2⟧, City Hall, Cathedral Square.
rows.quest:373:details:1: BIt appears to be recently written and sealed.
rows.quest:373:completion:0: Edwin VanCleef, you say? I would as much expect a letter from my dead grandmother... So you've killed him then? Pardon me in saying, but I'm somewhat surprised. He was a peerless fighter in his younger years. Let's see what he finds the need to write to me about after so many years.
rows.quest:373:completion:2: BEdwin... I see the years haven't changed you a bit, an idealist as ever, and a romantic. He doesn't care who he hurts, ⟦9⟧. ⟦E12⟧ has consumed him. But then, I'm not sure I can blame him.
rows.quest:389:obj:0: Speak with Warden Thelwater in the Stockade.
rows.quest:389:details:0: VanCleef and I were members of the Stonemasons Guild. Our main project was to rebuild ⟦E2⟧ after the War.
rows.quest:389:details:1: BWhen we had finished our duties, we were cheated. The nobles refused to pay us for our work. Some of the more senior of the Stonemasons were offered governmental jobs, but VanCleef refused it out of loyalty to all the Stonemasons. He led a riot and left the city, swearing revenge.
rows.quest:389:details:2: BHis lieutenant, Bazil Thredd, might know more about VanCleef's plans. He's being held prisoner in the Stockade.
rows.quest:389:completion:0: What in the Light do you want? Can't you see we have a crisis here?
rows.quest:389:completion:1: BBazil Thredd?! Why would you want to speak with that bastard? How am I supposed to know you're not one of his cronies, come down to help with his bloody riot? If all the blasted cells weren't open, I might throw you in one for a while!
rows.quest:392:obj:0: Bring the Sealed Description of Thredd's Visitor to Baros Alexston in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:392:details:0: During the first years of Thredd's imprisonment, he never had any visitors. I figured that he was no longer of use to the Brotherhood, so they abandoned him.
rows.quest:392:details:1: BAnyway, a few months ago, that all changed; he started to get regular visits... once, maybe twice a week. It was a strange man--the quiet type. I had my suspicions, but all his papers checked out.
rows.quest:392:details:2: BHis documents claimed his name was Maelik; here's his description. I don't think he'll be coming to visit Thredd anymore.
rows.quest:392:completion:0: Hmm. Maelik? No, the name doesn't sound familiar and neither does this description. But it could be anybody! A former Stonemason, one of the Defias Brotherhood... Though if he is as well connected as Thelwater suggests, perhaps someone else might recognize him. Let me think.
rows.quest:393:obj:0: Bring the Sealed Description of Thredd's Visitor to Master Mathias Shaw in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:393:details:0: I really haven't a clue, ⟦10⟧. There is someone else who might be able to help you, and it so happens that he owes me a favor for--well, let's not get into that. Master Mathias Shaw of SI:7 can be found in the barracks in Old Town. Shaw has his thumb on most of the shady, or underhanded dealings of the city.
rows.quest:393:details:1: BIf anyone knows, it'd be him.
rows.quest:393:completion:0: What? What's this? Yes, I think I do know who this man is, but his name is not Maelik. Assassins wear many names and many masks, discarding them as they lose their usefulness. Another alias known to be used by this man is Marzon; though even that is surely not his true name.
rows.quest:393:completion:1: BRegardless, he is an assassin and I know a good deal about him.
rows.quest:393:completion:2: BMarzon is currently under the employ of Lord Gregor Lescovar, a lord of shady reputation, even given the corruption of the nobility of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:394:details:0: Find Shaw in Old Town. Let him know that the Lescovar threat has been dealt with and about your involvement in the Lord's plots against the city. I'm sure he'll be proud to have another hero among ⟦E2⟧'s citizens.
rows.quest:394:details:1: BHe'll more than likely send you off to meet with the Prince or some other noble. Don't let it get to your head, ⟦11⟧. The nobles can think they rule the city all they want, but some things remain out of their hands.
rows.quest:394:completion:0: He is dead, then? Your justice was swift, ⟦12⟧. I pray to the Light that I never become your quarry!
rows.quest:394:completion:1: B<He laughs and claps you on the shoulder.>
rows.quest:394:completion:2: BI mean no criticism, ⟦13⟧. How could I, being the master of all assassins? But in truth, you have done the people of ⟦E2⟧ a great service, and for that, I thank you.
rows.quest:395:details:0: Ah, I almost forgot. Alexston came while you were away, he wished to speak with you. No doubt he wishes to report the goings-on of the Defias Brotherhood to the nobles.
rows.quest:395:details:1: BA bit of advice, ⟦14⟧: if anyone should ask, I would provide all details but that it was your hand that slew Lescovar. Trust me. I am... acquainted... with the ways of such things.
rows.quest:395:details:2: BAnd as far as Trias goes, well, speak to no one of him... ever... if you can help it.
rows.quest:395:completion:0: It's good to see you, ⟦15⟧. I have heard that Lord Gregor Lescovar was found dead not long ago.
rows.quest:395:completion:1: BIt would seem that you were successful in your mission. You have my gratitude that you have saved me, and many others, from VanCleef's revenge.
rows.quest:396:obj:0: Deliver Baros Alexston's report on the Defias Brotherhood to King Varian Wrynn in ⟦E2⟧ Keep.
rows.quest:396:details:0: I have prepared a report for the King. I believe you should be the one to deliver it to him, along with an account of your findings. Do not worry, there is no doubt that he will commend you for doing your duty to the people of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:396:details:1: BYour audience is scheduled soon, so you'd best hurry, it's a bit of a ways to ⟦E2⟧ Keep.
rows.quest:396:completion:0: You are to be commended for the service you have done for ⟦E2⟧, ⟦16⟧. If VanCleef had been successful in his machinations, he would no doubt have done considerable harm to the kingdom - something we must obviously avoid.
rows.quest:396:completion:1: BTake this, ⟦17⟧, as a token of the King's appreciation. I am only sorry he cannot present it to you himself, but he is away on a diplomatic mission and shall not return for some time.
rows.quest:397:obj:0: Speak with Zggi, the servant of Zardeth the Blackclaw, to claim your reward.
rows.quest:397:details:0: I hear Lord Wishock enjoyed his beverage.
rows.quest:397:details:1: BYou have served us well, ⟦18⟧. The Warlocks of ⟦E2⟧ will be able to practice our ways without disturbance, thanks to you. For your efforts, I have prepared a special gift for you. Speak with my servant, Zggi, and claim your reward.
rows.quest:397:completion:0: Master says give gift to ⟦19⟧. Zggi wants to keep nice gift but Zggi knows better than to betray Master.
rows.quest:399:obj:0: Go to Baros Alexston's house in ⟦E13⟧ and search for his compass, then return it to him in Cathedral Square of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:399:details:0: It seems an eternity since I was a boy working the farm in ⟦E13⟧. They say you can never go back, and it's true. Doubly true in my case, my family's home has been burned down and taken over by thieves.
rows.quest:399:details:1: BI have spoken with my father about the fate of some of my possessions, including my first compass. He was unable to save them. However, he also says that they should be hidden away on the farm.
rows.quest:399:details:2: BYou'll find the Alexston Farmstead west of Sentinel Hill. Perhaps you could go and retrieve it for me?
rows.quest:399:completion:0: Oh, thank you, ⟦20⟧! It's of no practical use to me, but the sentimental value... Needless to say, thank you for bringing this to me... at some cost to your own well-being, not to mention the time it took to go all the way down to ⟦E13⟧. You have my gratitude, and have this as a token of my thanks.
rows.quest:434:obj:0: Remain in the garden until Lord Gregor Lescovar and Marzon the Silent Blade have had their conversation. Afterwards, kill them both before returning to Elling Trias in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:434:details:0: After I put on Spybot's disguise, he'll head in to talk to Lescovar. The guards should let him pass no problem.
rows.quest:434:details:1: BWhile you were getting materials for me, I took care of informing Marzon that it was time for him and Lescovar to meet again. I even dropped some false information.
rows.quest:434:details:2: BLescovar will dismiss his guards and wait for Marzon out here in the garden. After you catch wind of talk about the Defias, make your move. You need to kill them both before the guards return! When you're done, speak to Trias.
rows.quest:434:completion:0: So it is done? Good. Thank you greatly for your discretion, ⟦21⟧. You've proven worthy on more than one count. I'll be sure to keep my eyes on you and your progress within the ⟦E14⟧.
rows.quest:434:completion:1: BBe sure to keep your nose clean.
rows.quest:538:details:0: ⟦22⟧. If you don't mind a long journey then I have a task for you, to again help ⟦E2⟧ fill its library.
rows.quest:538:details:1: BThe old kingdom of Alterac fell after the great war, and it had a large collection of books. It's a tragedy that the city is ruined, but even more tragic is all of their knowledge lost! We must recover what we can.
rows.quest:538:details:2: BSouthshore is the closest town to the Ruins of Alterac. Go there and speak with Loremaster Dibbs. He can direct you to the ruins, and to what books may be found there.
rows.quest:538:completion:0: Ah yes, I remember Milton. A bookworm, no doubt. Bless him.
rows.quest:538:completion:1: BAnd he's right. The Ruins of Alterac still hold stores of knowledge in danger of being lost!
rows.quest:538:completion:2: BOgres now dwell in Alterac, and they don't care much for higher learning.
rows.quest:540:obj:0: Bring 5 Recovered Tomes and the Worn Leather Book containing The Arm of Gri'lek to Loremaster Dibbs in ⟦E15⟧.
rows.quest:540:details:0: Those beastly ogres now reside within Alterac's ruins, and I shudder to think what they're doing with the precious books still there. You must recover what you can!
rows.quest:540:details:1: BEnter the Ruins of Alterac and search for tomes looted by the ogres. Get whatever you can find and bring them to me, but also seek out one book in particular: The Arm of Gri'lek. It contains ancient troll lore that I must learn, and the Ruins of Alterac was the last known location of an intact copy of this book.
rows.quest:540:completion:0: Oh, you got them! Splendid! I must begin studying the Arm of Gri'lek immediately!
rows.quest:542:obj:0: Bring the Tomes of Alterac to Milton Sheaf in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:542:details:0: I need to spend some time studying the Arm of Gri'lek book you brought me, though I'm sure Milton is eager to get the other recovered books into ⟦E2⟧'s collection.
rows.quest:542:details:1: BHere are the books you gathered from the Ruins of Alterac, packed and catalogued. Take them back to Milton Sheaf in ⟦E2⟧ and I'm sure he'll be grateful.
rows.quest:542:completion:0: My oh my! Look at these! I can't believe they survived the ruination of Alterac. And all those ogres too!
rows.quest:542:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦23⟧. Thank you so much! You have helped preserve human knowledge, and you add to the grandeur of the Royal Library of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:543:obj:0: Bring the Perenolde Tiara to Remington Ridgewell in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:543:details:0: The Perenolde Tiara is an old heirloom of the Perenolde "nobles" - the ruling family of Alterac before that kingdom fell to ruin. It is said to have been crafted by master jewelers in ⟦E11⟧, and fitted with the finest of emeralds.
rows.quest:543:details:1: BWhen Alterac was destroyed the Tiara was lost, but there are rumors that an Ogre Mage, Grel'borg the Miser, found the tiara and now wanders the Ruins of Alterac searching for more treasures.
rows.quest:543:details:2: BWe would have you acquire the tiara for us.
rows.quest:543:completion:0: Ah, this is splendid. This will have to be cleaned of course, but you really outdid yourself, ⟦24⟧. I will have someone prepare the tiara and place it within our collection posthaste.
rows.quest:690:obj:0: Find Skuerto at Refuge Pointe in the ⟦E16⟧.
rows.quest:690:details:0: Greetings, ⟦25⟧. You have the look of an adventurer about you, and I have a task that needs some tending to.
rows.quest:690:details:1: BArchmage Trelane, my original master, fled Stromgarde in the ⟦E16⟧ not too long ago, and he's asked me to help him in recovering some of the items he left behind.
rows.quest:690:details:2: BThe city fell under siege, and he attempted to defend the Tower of Arathor, but to no avail. I have agents in the Highlands already, but they've requested I send more aid. Are you interested?
rows.quest:690:completion:0: So, Malin sent ye? I don't care if Muradin rose up from the dead and whisked ye here on a dragon. I'm busy! Talk to Kryten if you need somethin'.
rows.quest:1015:obj:0: Speak with Arch ⟦E17⟧ Fandral Staghelm at the Cenarion Enclave of ⟦E18⟧ about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of ⟦E19⟧.
rows.quest:1015:details:1: BThe Cenarion Circle seeks able bodied individuals to assist them in exploring the vast new frontiers of ⟦E19⟧! A forbidden wasteland of unimaginable dangers lies far to the west of ⟦E20⟧ and Gadgetzan, and the Circle needs willing and honorable proxies to act in their stead.
rows.quest:1015:details:2: BAll interested individuals should seek audience with the Cenarion Circle. Speak with the Arch ⟦E17⟧ in ⟦E18⟧, Fandral Staghelm, for more information!
rows.quest:1015:completion:0: What makes you think I wish to be pestered by the likes of you, ⟦26⟧? Wait - let me stop the important duties I attend to on a daily basis so I can help you locate a doodad somewhere. By all means, the welfare of ⟦E18⟧ - nay, all of ⟦E21⟧ - should come second to the acquisition of a bauble for your collection.
rows.quest:1015:completion:1: BThe fools in ⟦E22⟧ waste my time with their call for assistance, and now I must endure this?
rows.quest:1097:details:0: There's a dwarven weaponsmith in ⟦E2⟧, Grimand Elmore, who sent word that he needs help with a delivery. I believe he wants a package sent to his homeland in the north.
rows.quest:1097:details:1: BYou have a sturdy pair on you! So if you're interested in some legwork then speak with Grimand. We could use you down here, but we must also keep our ties strong with the dwarves.
rows.quest:1097:details:2: BYou can find Grimand Elmore at the weapon shop in the Dwarven District of ⟦E2⟧, in the northeast section of town.
rows.quest:1097:completion:0: You're here to help with my delivery? Very good!
rows.quest:1241:details:0: Recently a diplomat was sent to ⟦E24⟧ to meet with Jaina Proudmoore. That diplomat never arrived.
rows.quest:1241:details:1: BI believe the Defias are involved in this plot, but I'm not sure how. The diplomat's disappearance still eludes public attention, but it can't remain that way for long.
rows.quest:1241:details:2: BAgents of the king are already scouring the city for clues, but I have my own contacts I would like involved.
rows.quest:1241:details:3: BIn the Valley of Heroes is an old friend of mine named Jorgen. Find him, give him this note, and follow his instructions.
rows.quest:1241:completion:0: Hmm... <Jorgen looks up at you through squinted eyes.>
rows.quest:1241:completion:1: BAll right. I'll help ya, but not because I want to, but because I'm obligated.
rows.quest:1241:completion:2: BAnd let's get one thing straight: you're knowin' far more than you should to begin with. Let's keep this our little secret, and don't go blabbin' at any taverns about anything you find out. Understand?
rows.quest:1242:obj:0: Delivery Jorgen's Sealed Note to Elling Trias in ⟦E23⟧.
rows.quest:1242:details:0: Take this here note to Elling Trias. Don't say nothin' else to him. Just be polite and wait for him to respond. And don't worry, he will.
rows.quest:1242:details:1: BI'm gonna only impress this on ya once more, ⟦27⟧: treat this matter seriously, and keep your yapper shut.
rows.quest:1242:details:2: BYa can find Trias at his cheese shop, Trias' Cheese, in the Trade District. Good luck.
rows.quest:1242:completion:0: I'm sorry, a letter for me? Well, I'll be... not often you get a delivery that's not a crate or barrel when all you do is work. Let's see what this is about.
rows.quest:1242:completion:1: B<Elling looks up at you while he opens the letter.>
rows.quest:1242:completion:2: BYou look a little tense, you okay, ⟦28⟧?
rows.quest:1243:obj:0: Give the Sealed Note to Watcher Backus in ⟦E25⟧.
rows.quest:1243:details:0: Jorgen, you ol' sonuva.... So, that's how it's going to be, huh?
rows.quest:1243:details:1: BAll right, I can deal with that. I hope he finds the ⟦E26⟧ that much sooner!
rows.quest:1243:details:2: BHere's what's gonna happen, ⟦29⟧. I'll start using my contacts here, but you're doing most of the footwork so I save some coin.
rows.quest:1243:details:3: BHead to Darkshire in ⟦E25⟧ and find Watcher Backus--he usually patrols the north road right outside of town. Just tell him you're looking into any Defias activity for me and he'll help you out with any information he can.
rows.quest:1243:completion:0: Oh, Trias sent you, huh? That's a little different.
rows.quest:1243:completion:1: BFeel free to fight whatever monstrosities come at you from the darkness. I'm sure you'll be able to handle it pretty easily if you're the type to be hanging around with the likes of him.
rows.quest:1243:completion:2: BSo, what does my friend need of me on such a gloomy day as this?
rows.quest:1244:obj:0: Find the Defias Docket and return it to Watcher Backus in ⟦E25⟧.
rows.quest:1244:details:0: Defias activity? Well, there's always some activity; even if they keep to themselves we consider them a threat.
rows.quest:1244:details:1: BBut now that I think about it, there was a recent sighting that seemed odd. It must have been a couple weeks ago, but some of their agents had gathered around Addle's Stead. From the report, I'd guessed something big went down.
rows.quest:1244:details:2: BWhy don't you check there first and bring me back anything you find?
rows.quest:1244:details:3: BThe farmstead is south of the road from ⟦E13⟧ just as you enter ⟦E25⟧.
rows.quest:1244:completion:0: You're back safe and sound. Couldn't ask for much more than that, could you?
rows.quest:1244:completion:1: BNow, let's see what we have here. This looks pretty official as far as any Defias documents I've seen. But it could be a dupe just to throw you off track of whatever it is you're looking for.
rows.quest:1245:obj:0: Bring the Defias Docket to Elling Trias in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1245:details:0: Whoa, this looks way too complex to be something to just lead you astray. I shouldn't even be looking at this stuff. Take it to Trias--he'll be able to make sense of it. And DON'T let anyone get in your way. This is bigger than me. It might even be bigger than him, but we'll see.
rows.quest:1245:details:1: BAnd do me a favor, ⟦30⟧, don't tell anyone I helped you. If my superiors found out I knew about any of this and didn't share it with them they'd probably hang me.
rows.quest:1245:completion:0: Yeah... this is an interesting read. Jorgen and DeLavey were smart to bring me in on this.
rows.quest:1245:completion:1: BSeems the Defias have been trying pretty hard to complete this plan of theirs. Hmm... what's this? Fist? That's a familiar name.
rows.quest:1246:details:0: Yeah, now that I think about it... Dashel... Dashel something... What was his name? FIST! Dashel Stonefist. They call him Fist in some circles--probably on account that he likes to get in brawls.
rows.quest:1246:details:1: BYou can find him in Old Town usually--right smack dab in the center of it. Go talk to him. If you have to, use a sword or something heavy and blunt to persuade him to open up some. And don't hesitate. If he's in this as deep as these papers suggest, then he's not going to give you any information willingly.
rows.quest:1246:completion:1: BYou come into me alley and ask questions about me personal business? Business which you obviously have nothing to do with.
rows.quest:1247:details:0: So yeah... um... I might know something 'bout that meeting at Addle's Stead. Happened a few weeks back I think. I really didn't have any part in it. Me part was done when plan A failed... damn adventurers.
rows.quest:1247:details:1: BThe guy we got on the inside for plan B came out of Menethil; guy called Slim. That's all I know regarding their backup plan.
rows.quest:1247:completion:0: Good to see you're still alive, ⟦31⟧. So, it went well with Dashel then, huh?
rows.quest:1247:completion:1: BI've been reading up more on this plan of theirs, and although it doesn't state the name of the diplomat they were after, it does talk about this plan B they enacted after failing on their first attempt to capture him.
rows.quest:1247:completion:2: BThis Slim that Dashel mentioned doesn't have any other name written here, but if you say he's in Menethil, then that's a start.
rows.quest:1248:details:0: A contact of mine retired in the ⟦E5⟧ at the harbor city of Menethil. He should be willing to help on your word alone if you tell him you're working for me. His name is Mikhail. He mentioned becoming a bartender before leaving ⟦E2⟧ a few years ago.
rows.quest:1248:details:1: BSpeak to him, find this Slim, and find out if there's anything else to know about this kidnapped diplomat. We need to find out where they've taken him, or at least who he is. The docket doesn't mention anything about their plans after he's captured.
rows.quest:1248:completion:0: Welcome, welcome, welcome, ⟦32⟧. Good of you to join us. Perhaps an ale today? Or some mutton?
rows.quest:1248:completion:1: BName your pleasure and I'll see to it that you're taken care of. My name is Mikhail, and I look forward to serving you.
rows.quest:1248:completion:2: BHmm? What's that? Trias? Keep your voice down, my friend. This isn't something for the whole tavern to hear about.
rows.quest:1249:obj:0: Subdue Tapoke Jahn before he escapes, and then return to Mikhail in Menethil.
rows.quest:1249:details:0: You say Elling sent you here? Well then, the hospitality I expressed is now tenfold. Anything you need, just ask. I will do my best to aid you.
rows.quest:1249:details:1: BHmm, Slim, you say? Not sure the name sounds familiar, but I'll keep my eyes out for him.
rows.quest:1249:details:2: BDon't look now, ⟦33⟧, but the gentleman over by the exit is looking over here. He's listening to our conversation a little too intently if you catch my meaning? If I were you, I'd do what you can to subdue him before he makes a break for the door.
rows.quest:1249:completion:0: Caught him, huh? Good for you. I'm surprised that was Slim.
rows.quest:1249:completion:1: BI'll be honest, I never thought I'd miss the excitement of some of the more devious underground activities. I guess old habits die hard. Don't mention that to Elling--he'd probably try and get me to come back to ⟦E2⟧ if he heard I missed the action.
rows.quest:1249:completion:2: BI'm glad I could at least be of a little service to you while you were in Menethil. If you need anything else, just ask.
rows.quest:1250:details:0: The Defias didn't pay me well enough to die for their cause. They took the king. Yeah, the king of ⟦E2⟧, not some lowly diplomat. He was on his way to ⟦E24⟧ to meet with Jaina Proudmore--it was a big deal apparently, and a big secret. But it's not just the Defias that are involved. They're working with someone. I think they knew this was bigger than them.
rows.quest:1250:details:1: BMy part was just to get their man on board the king's ship while it was in the harbor. The guy's name was Hendel. That's all I know. I swear!
rows.quest:1250:completion:0: THE KING?! I mean... the king? The real king? Are you joking? You didn't mention you were looking for the king's kidnappers. I didn't even hear he was missing--that would explain his son being crowned some.
rows.quest:1250:completion:1: BI'll send word to Elling right away. He'll want to know you're on the trail.
rows.quest:1250:completion:2: BI would never have guessed Jahn would sell out ⟦E2⟧ for some lousy coin. Even a rogue's got to have honor when it comes to some things.
rows.quest:1250:completion:3: BThe key now is to find this Hendel. And I think I can help with that.
